objective: Order all remaining Chelsea EV-eligible slots for valuation research by economic relevance without pretending unvalued cards already have market values.

prohibited_interpretations: Do not report the proxy as predicted card market value.
Do not report the proxy as EV contribution.
Do not sum proxy values into team EV.
Do not use the proxy to unlock ROI.

market_anchor_precedence: Chelsea category median when at least three observations exist

confidence_policy.high: Same subject/category with at least three valued observations.
confidence_policy.medium: Same subject/category with one or two valued observations.
confidence_policy.low: Cross-category subject transfer or Chelsea category/team fallback.

multi_subject_policy: Use the highest available subject anchor for prioritization. This is intentionally conservative toward missing a star-driven research opportunity and is not a valuation rule.
ordering: stronger anchor basis before weaker basis when proxy ties
category, set, card number and parallel deterministic tie-breakers
completion_rule: Every one of Chelsea's 638 eligible contribution slots must either have committed EV provenance or appear exactly once in the completion queue.
